name: companion-mcp
description: Create and maintain Bitfocus Companion 5.1 configuration (pages, buttons, actions, feedbacks) with validation, dry-run import and read-back verification.
long_description: MCP server for Bitfocus Companion 5.1.x, focused on configuration creation. Config is generated as an export file, validated offline, and only imported through a gated write path (off by default, dry run first, checksummed snapshot, read-back diff). See the project README for the safety model.

companion_url.title: Companion URL
companion_url.description: Admin address of Companion, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000.

rest_token.title: REST API token (optional)
rest_token.description: Token (cpn_...) of Companion's REST API v2. Only needed for connection and surface listing. Leave empty if unused.

write_enabled.title: Allow writing to Companion
write_enabled.description: Off by default. When on, companion_import_page, companion_rollback and companion_press may change Companion. Imports still default to dry run.

allowed_hosts.title: Allowed hosts
allowed_hosts.description: Comma-separated hosts the server may contact. Default is loopback only. Add the host of Companion if it runs on another machine.

press_allow.title: Allowed button presses (optional)
press_allow.description: Comma-separated page/row/column entries, for example 99/0/0. Empty means no restriction (still needs the write option).

allow_unknown_version.title: Accept untested Companion versions
allow_unknown_version.description: Only 5.1.x is tested. Turning this on is at your own risk.
